gaps.title: Missing password configuration mechanism for autonomous fallback
gaps.jtbd: When the external LMS fails, I want to use my autonomous fallback account with a known password, so that I can continue accessing the archive
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an auto-provisioned SSO user with an unknown generated fallback password, When the user accesses their profile, Then they can securely set or change their fallback password
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: a fallback authentication system requiring local passwords must provide users a way to securely configure those passwords, otherwise auto-provisioned accounts cannot use the fallback.
